persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Make an 8-second widescreen mini-documentary introducing the real F-35A Lightning II. Show it taking off from a runway, then flying. Label it 'F-35A Lightning II', with 'One engine' and 'Conventional takeoff' appearing in turn. Calm English narration explaining those two facts. Real aircraft proportions, not a sci-fi jet.
bank.Aircraft and variant: The real F-35A Lightning II, not the F-35B or F-35C.
bank.On-screen wording: F-35A Lightning II; One engine; Conventional takeoff.
bank.Narration: Calm English narration explaining that the F-35A has one engine and takes off conventionally from a runway; exact wording and voice are your call.
bank.Visual style and setting: Realistic documentary imagery; runway location, weather and camera angles are your call.
bank.Music: Your call, provided the narration remains clear.

messages.text: Please make a little mini-documentary introducing the real F-35A Lightning II, because I want it to feel like a straightforward introduction to the actual aircraft. I sometimes worry that aircraft videos end up looking more like imaginary movie jets than the real thing. What I have in mind is showing it taking off from a runway and then flying, and the whole thing should be 8 seconds long and widescreen. Put the label 'F-35A Lightning II' on it, with 'One engine' and 'Conventional takeoff' appearing in turn. Please use calm English narration explaining those two facts, meaning that it has one engine and takes off conventionally from a runway. Keep the aircraft proportions real rather than making it look like a sci-fi jet.
